subject: On-prem air-gapped deployment: hardware & offline ops follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@legacybank.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@legacybank.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>, michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-01T16:10:00Z
Subject: Post-call: on-prem air-gapped qual / next steps

Hi Sam / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same view.

Key takeaways:
- Legacy Bank is leaning toward a Private on-prem, air-gapped deployment due to regulatory requirements and data residency.
- Primary workloads: PII extraction and customer support triage (peak: 200 qps inference, 3k tokens/session average).
- Non-functional: 10ms token latency SLO for interactive flows, offline batch jobs ok with higher latency.
- Networking: no outbound internet from the inference cluster; control plane can be in a Bastion VPC with limited egress (TBD).

Open qualification questions (items we need to confirm):
1) Rack space & hardware: do you have preferred vendors / existing rack inventory? We suggested 2-3x A100/RTX-class servers for initial capacity but need exact CPU/memory/network constraints.
2) Upgrade path: how often can we schedule maintenance windows for kernel/driver/quantization updates? Air-gapped processes require an approved change window.
3) Offline ops: who will own physical media and transfer (Ops team contact)? We typically ship signed artifacts and offer an on-site flashing procedure.

Next steps I propose:
- Sam: share rack/uplink details and current hardware spreadsheet (hw_specs_rack_list.xlsx) — can you send by EOD Friday?
- Dev (cc): once we have the rack spec, we’ll produce a recommended node list and a short ops runbook for air-gap procedures.
- Michael: I’ll coordinate a follow-up with Security to walk through SOC2 evidence and the offline artifact signing process.

Attachments: initial HW spec template (hw_specs_rack_list.xlsx), example network topology (network_topology.png).

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
Direct: +1 415-555-0186

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@legacybank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@legacybank.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-02T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: on-prem air-gapped qual / next steps

Marissa — thanks for the detailed notes. A few quick answers below and I attached the preliminary rack inventory.

Answers:
- Rack inventory: attached (hw_specs_rack_list.xlsx). We currently have two 42U racks in our secure vaults. Each rack has 100Gbps uplinks to the internal fabric; isolated from internet.
- Vendor: we prefer HPE/Cisco blade chassis but open to recommendations.
- Maintenance windows: our change board meets bi-weekly; for major kernel/driver updates we require a 2-week lead and we have one maintenance window every month (Sunday 02:00–06:00 local).
- Offline transfer: Ops contact is Priya Rao (cc). We typically accept signed USB drives or encrypted NVMe shipped with chain-of-custody.

Attachments: hw_specs_rack_list.xlsx

Sam

Subject: Re: Post-call: on-prem air-gapped qual / next steps

Sam / Marissa — thanks for the rack sheet, that's really helpful. A couple of notes from an infra/ops perspective after a quick pass: 

- Node recommendations: based on your qps and token sizes, we recommend starting with 3x GPU nodes (each: 8x A100 80GB or equivalent), 2x control nodes (32 vCPU, 256GB RAM), and 1x NFS metadata node for model/artifact storage. I’ll put a formal spec in the Drive folder.
- Networking: since the cluster is air-gapped, we will provide an initial image bundle and signed artifacts. For kernel/driver updates we support an offline update bundle and a checklist for chain-of-custody.
- Offline ops runbook: we’ll include steps for media verification (SHA256), secure transfer, and rollback. This runbook will be tailored to your maintenance cadence.

Can you confirm whether the two racks have redundant power PDUs and the exact uplink port mapping? That will affect how we recommend NIC configurations.

I’ll upload the detailed node spec and an ops runbook draft to the shared Drive by tomorrow.

Best — Dev

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@legacybank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@legacybank.com>, security@legacybank.com, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-05T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: on-prem air-gapped qual / next steps

Hi all — quick update from our side after reviewing the documents: 

- Power: yes, both racks have redundant PDUs (A and B) and dual UPS feeds.
- Uplink mapping: I attached a short diagram (network_topology.png) showing which switches map to which rack ports.
- Security checklist: security@legacybank.com will need a short evidence package for SOC2 controls related to media handling. Could Redwood provide a redacted SOC2 report and a sample artifact-signing manifest?

We are good to proceed with your proposed node counts for the PoC. Please post the formal node spec and the offline ops runbook to the Drive link and we will review during the next change board.

Thanks — Priya
